title: Quiet and private nestled by the Koi Pond
description:
Hummingbirds and koi fish greet you for coffee on your private patio. 

This camper has everything! Queen size bed on one side and twin camping mattress on the other. Bathroom with shower, full size refrigerator, dishwasher, microwave, stove and oven, washer/dryer, coffee maker, TV, wifi, hair dryer.  Parking in the driveway. 

Perfect for a couple or single traveler, but room for one more.

Quiet Green Hills neighborhood. About 15 minutes from the airport and 15 minutes from downtown.
